ns2:course.label: Random Processes
ns2:course.description: Basic concepts of random processes; linear systems with random inputs; Markov processes; spectral analysis; Wiener and Kalman filtering; applications to systems engineering. Prerequisite: One of ECE 313, MATH 461, STAT 400.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of ECE 313, MATH 461, STAT 400.
